[Suggested upload date: 2026-09-02]

AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE MASTER SERVICE AGREEMENT

Amendment No. 1 to the Master Service Agreement between Solstice Retail
Group, Inc. and Cobalt Digital Solutions, LLC dated 2 March 2026.

Dated: 25 August 2026

WHEREAS the Parties wish to update certain master terms applicable to all
Statements of Work issued under the Agreement, including SOW-001 and
SOW-002;

NOW THEREFORE the Parties agree as follows:

1. LIABILITY CAP. Section 5 (Limitation of Liability) of the Agreement is
amended to increase the liability cap from twelve (12) months' fees to
eighteen (18) months' fees paid in the preceding eighteen (18) months.

2. DATA SECURITY ADDENDUM. A new Section 9A (Data Security) is added to the
Agreement, requiring Vendor to provide Client with an annual SOC 2 Type II
report covering the systems used to deliver Services under any Statement of
Work.

3. PAYMENT TERMS. Section 3 (Payment Terms) is amended so that invoices
exceeding USD 100,000 are payable within thirty (30) days (net-30) rather
than forty-five (45) days; invoices at or below USD 100,000 remain net-45.

4. APPLICATION. This Amendment applies to the Agreement and to all
Statements of Work currently in effect, including SOW-001 (as modified by
Change Order No. 1) and SOW-002, from the date first written above.

5. NO OTHER CHANGES. Except as expressly amended herein, the Agreement
remains in full force and effect.

For SOLSTICE RETAIL GROUP, INC.          For COBALT DIGITAL SOLUTIONS, LLC
Name: T. Whitfield                        Name: A. Marchetti
Title: Chief Operating Officer            Title: VP Client Engagements
